ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, PA and PB are tangent lines to the circle $O$, with A and B being the points of tangency. AC is a diameter of the circle $O$. Given that $\angle P = 50^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle ACB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OB, as shown in the diagram,\\
since PA and PB are tangents to the circle centered at O,\\
it follows that OA $\perp$ PA, and OB $\perp$ PB,\\
thus, $\angle$OAP=$\angle$OBP=90$^\circ$,\\
hence, $\angle$AOB=360$^\circ$-90$^\circ$-90$^\circ$-50$^\circ$=130$^\circ$,\\
since OB=OC,\\
it follows that $\angle$OCB=$\angle$OBC,\\
and since $\angle$AOB=$\angle$OCB+$\angle$OBC,\\
thus, $\angle$OCB= $\frac{1}{2} \times 130^\circ=65^\circ$,\\
that is, $\angle$ACB=$\boxed{65^\circ}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is circle O, A is above the circle, B is below the circle and slightly to the right, C is below the circle and slightly to the left; the external point P on the right draws two lines PA and PB, which are tangent to the circle at A and B respectively; AC passes through the center O, indicating that AC is a diameter; the figure asks to find ∠ACB from ∠P=50°. Reasoning: PA and PB are two tangents drawn from the same external point P, so PA=PB, and triangle PAB is an isosceles triangle. Given that the vertex angle ∠APB=50°, the base angles ∠PAB=∠PBA=(180°-50°)/2=65°. ∠PAB is the angle formed by tangent PA and chord AB. By the tangent-chord theorem, this angle is equal to the inscribed angle ∠ACB subtended by chord AB on the opposite side of the circle. Therefore ∠ACB=65°.

From the text, use that PA and PB are tangents and that ∠P = 50°. Since tangent segments from the same external point are equal, PA = PB, so triangle PAB is isosceles. Thus the base angles are ∠PAB = ∠PBA = (180° - 50°)/2 = 65°. Then apply the tangent-chord theorem: the angle between tangent PA and chord AB equals the angle in the opposite arc subtending chord AB, which is ∠ACB. Therefore ∠ACB = 65°.
